idea: Substitute the given values into the defining equation, then multiply by the conjugate of the impedance and simplify using I² = −1.
proof:
have h : i * (2 - Complex.I) = 1 + Complex.I := by
    calc
      i * (2 - Complex.I) = i * z := by rw [h₂]
      _ = v := h₀.symm
      _ = 1 + Complex.I := h₁
  have hI : Complex.I ^ 2 = -1 := Complex.I_sq
  linear_combination ((2 + Complex.I) / 5) * h + ((i + 1) / 5) * hI
